_comment: Circle agent wallet config for the agent's Market (1F3EA) use: listing fees and sales. City actions use fee credits, not this wallet. Copy to wallet-config.json and fill in your values. NON-SECRET: no private key, login code, or session token ever goes here. See WALLET-SETUP.example.md.

session.note: Circle sessions expire; the operator logs in again with `circle wallet login` (code by email) before paying.
